No-show fee - Driver cancelled on me while I was walking to the bay.

No-show feeFiled by riderContested SGD 6.00Decided automatically - 190.4 s

This is a provisional ruling made by an automated system.

Fee stands, driver compensated DRIVER_COMPENSATION

The fee stands. The driver is paid SGD 4.80. No refund.

From the judge's explanation

To the rider: your $6.00 cancellation fee stands and no refund is due, because all four conditions POL-NS-01 requires before a no-show fee may be charged are met on this record. (a) The trip record EV-TRIP-02705 carries the driver's 'I'm Here' event at 18:18:27. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-02705 places him inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius (POL-NS-02; fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m) from that same second, with 57 consecutive qualifying in-geofence fixes at 10 s cadence, 100% coverage and no gaps. (c) His continuous in-geofence dwell was 556 seconds, from 18:18:27 to 18:27:43 — 76 seconds more than the 480-second free waiting period in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 480). (d) The trip was ended by the driver at 18:27:44 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell had elapsed, with no boarding event. Because the arrival marker here is a driver-pressed BUTTON, it was tested under POL-NS-05 and is not false — the first qualifying in-geofence fix is in the same second, and no admissible fix puts the driver beyond 300 m or at 15 km/h or more at the marker. Your own account, that you were walking to the bay, is not supported by the evidence: your device's fixes in EV-GPS-02705 sit between 789 m and 796 m from the pickup pin for the whole window, every one at 0.0 km/h, with no qualifying fix inside the 200 m rider presence radius. POL-NS-04 therefore cannot exonerate you — you sent no locating or coordinating message (the only chat message in EV-CHAT-02705 is the driver's, at 18:18:57) and limb (c) is affirmatively failed, so POL-NS-11's undecidable route is not in play. POL-NS-06's shortfall route is not engaged either (a 76-second surplus, not a shortfall), and POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02705-01 (status MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) bore only on POL-NS-06(i), which neither side needed. To the driver: the fee is upheld and you are paid the compensation POL-NS-07 fixes — 80 percent of the $6.00 fee, which is $4.80 — and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 57, so neither the count nor the rate limb is met (the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is not the field that check reads). The fare line reconciles — the $6.00 charged in EV-FARE-02705 matches platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of $6.00 — so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. Because a payment to the driver is the outcome, the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and, per POL-GEN-03, amount_sgd carries the same $4.80; the rider's charge is not refunded. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict one another on arrival, dwell or rider presence, neither profile shows cross-disputes in the trailing 90 days, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below the 3 limb (d) reads), and the anti-farming check is clear. No clause produces a referral. The monetary effect, $4.80, does not exceed the $8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05). The rider's kept claims — which correctly decline to press POL-NS-04, POL-NS-06 and POL-NS-11 — and the driver's kept claims are all accepted and are reflected above. No claim rested on a context-only profile field.

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.80 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

For the rider: your claim that the driver cancelled while you were walking to the bay is not supported on this record. Your own device's track (EV-GPS-02705) shows it stationary at 0.0 km/h and 789–796 m from the Changi T3 pickup pin for the whole waiting window (18:16:27–18:28:18), with zero qualifying fixes inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius. The driver's one message at 18:18:57 ("I am at the bay, which door are you at") was read by you at 18:19:47 and never answered. POL-NS-04 therefore does not exonerate you: its limb (a) fails (no locating or coordinating message from you), and its limb (c) fails affirmatively rather than being undecidable under POL-NS-11. POL-NS-06 gives you nothing either, and you correctly did not press it — the dwell exceeds the minimum, so there is no shortfall to refund. For the driver: all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold. (a) The trip record (EV-TRIP-02705) carries your 'I'm Here' arrival event at 18:18:27. (b) The exported GPS trace (EV-GPS-02705) places you inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius at that moment, with 57 qualifying in-geofence fixes out of 113 at 10 s cadence, 100.0 percent coverage and no gaps, closest approach 0.11 m from the pin — the trace carries limbs (b) and (c) on its own evidence, since the BUTTON marker is outside POL-NS-12's GPS_AUTO route. (c) That trace shows a continuous in-geofence dwell of 556 s (18:18:27–18:27:43), 76 s more than the 480 s free waiting period in force (platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 480). (d) The trip was terminated by you at 18:27:44 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed, with no boarding event and no started_at. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee: you were at the pin, so this is not a POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance case; your marker was not false under POL-NS-05, because the first qualifying fix coincides with the tap and no admissible fix puts you beyond 300 m or at 15 km/h or more at that moment; and POL-NS-06's shortfall route is not engaged. POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable because EV-ADVIS-02705-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY) is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, but nothing turns on it — your single uninterrupted run already meets the minimum. This ruling is addressed to both parties. It concerns the $6.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02705 (EV-FARE-02705: cancellation_fee SGD 6.00, total_charged SGD 6.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), after the driver cancelled at 18:27:44 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold, so the fee is chargeable and stands. (a) EV-TRIP-02705 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:18:27 for this trip. (b) EV-GPS-02705 places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius from 18:18:27, with 57 consecutive qualifying in-geofence fixes and a closest approach of 0.11 m, so the POL-NS-02 proximity test is met. (c) The continuous in-geofence dwell is 556 seconds (18:18:27 to 18:27:43), 76 seconds more than the 480-second free waiting period in force for this AIRPORT trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 480), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as POL-NS-01(c) requires; no longer no_show_threshold_sec applies. (d) The record shows no boarding event and no started_at, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 18:27:44, after the required dwell elapsed, with RIDER_NO_SHOW, a code limb (d) recognises. No displacing clause fires. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius, not in the 150 m to 400 m wrong-entrance band, and registered_pickup_points is 1, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-05 does not apply: the first qualifying in-geofence fix falls at 18:18:27, the same second as the marker, so the marker is not false and there is no recomputed shortfall. POL-NS-06 does not apply: 556 s exceeds the 480 s minimum by 76 s, so there is no premature-cancellation shortfall to refund. The rider's point that a failed limb of POL-NS-01 would produce a full $6.00 refund is correct as a matter of law (POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06), but no limb fails on this record, so it does not move the outcome. The rider's own submissions correctly concede that POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate them (the only chat message is the driver's, at 18:18:57; the rider's track sits roughly 790 m away, outside the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed, not undecidable under POL-NS-11), that POL-NS-06 shows a surplus rather than a shortfall, and that the fare line reconciles. The driver's corresponding points on limbs (a)-(d), on POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-06, and on the absence of any POL-NS-09 trigger are accepted. Driver compensation: POL-NS-07 fixes the payout at 80 percent of the $6.00 fee in force = $4.80 (EV-FARE-02705, derived.money.driver_compensation = $4.80; driver_compensation_rate 0.8). The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 against completed_trips_30d of 57, so neither the count limb (4 or more) nor the rate limb (above 0.08) is met, and the payout is not withheld. Per POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-03, where compensation is paid the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd; the rider's $6.00 charge itself stands. EV-ADVIS-02705-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. It can carry no fact. Its absence makes the POL-NS-06 limb (i) accumulation route unavailable, but no accumulation is needed here, so nothing in this ruling rests on it. A driver-side claim citing it without naming its issue code was discarded by the referee (see the discarded claims). No POL-NS-09 escalation is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no admissible artifacts contradict one another on arrival, dwell or rider presence; both parties show 0 disputes_with_counterparty_90d; the anti-farming check does not trip and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below 3); and no deciding artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d). Every artifact the ruling rests on (trip record, GPS trace, fare breakdown) is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. No clause produces a referral, so none is included. The monetary effect, $4.80, does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00. The rider's claim is not supported and the present state stands.
